k:順.mnemonic: Pages (頁) of orders come down like a river (川), each one following the one before, and the clerk does what each says in its turn. Obey (order, turn, docility).
k:順.hint: Orders flowing down one by one.

k:暗.mnemonic: Step out of the sun into the cave and there is only sound (音): footsteps, a drip, your own breathing, and nothing at all to see. Darkness (shade, grow dark, disappear).
k:暗.hint: Nothing to see, only to hear.

k:仲.mnemonic: A leader (亻) who stands in the middle (中) between two quarrelling families and carries messages from one side to the other. Go-between (relationship).

k:討.mnemonic: The master will say (言) exactly what you did wrong, each word dealt out by measurement (寸) like a rap from a ruler. Chastise (attack, defeat, conquer).
k:討.hint: Words like raps from a ruler.

k:印.mnemonic: A stick (｜) of carved stone is pressed into red ink and then down onto the paper like a stamp (卩), leaving your mark. Seal (stamp, mark, imprint).
k:印.hint: Carved stone pressed in red ink.

k:折.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) bend the paper over and run along the crease until it is as sharp as the edge of an axe (斤). Fold (break, bend, yield).
k:折.hint: A crease sharp as a blade.

k:植.mnemonic: By mutual (相) agreement each neighbour digs ten (十) holes along the road and sets a sapling upright in every one. Plant.
k:植.hint: Neighbours setting saplings along the road.

k:浦.mnemonic: The fishermen's task (用) when a tsunami (氵) warning sounds: row the boats into the sheltered curve of the coast, where the water stays calm. Bay (creek, inlet, gulf).
k:浦.hint: Boats rowed into the sheltered curve.

k:逃.mnemonic: Legs (儿) racing down the path (辶), slipping past the icicles (冫) on the prison gate and away into the winter night. Escape (flee, evade, set free).
k:逃.hint: Legs racing from the icy gate.

k:弱.mnemonic: A bow (弓) hung with icicles (冫): the frozen wood has gone brittle and the string limp, and the second bow beside it is no better. Weak (frail).

k:爆.mnemonic: Someone drops fire (火) down the well (井), against every rule in the safety code (典), and the water (水) goes up with a tremendous bang. Bomb (burst open, pop, split).
k:爆.hint: Fire down the well, then bang.

k:巨.mnemonic: A carpenter's square drawn enormous, with a grip in the middle because it takes a whole arm to lift it. Gigantic (big, large, huge).

k:革.mnemonic: An animal hide stretched out to dry: the head at the top, the body pegged open in the middle, and the tail hanging below. Leather (skin, reform).
k:革.hint: A hide pegged out to dry.

k:舎.mnemonic: A thatched roof like a hat (𠆢), walls of packed soil (土), and one door for a mouth (口): a little house out in the country. Cottage (inn, hut, house).
k:舎.hint: Thatch hat, earth walls, one door.

k:養.mnemonic: An orphan lamb: every few hours you give the little sheep (羊) something to eat (食) from a bottle, until it is fully grown. Foster (bring up, rear, nurture).

k:閣.mnemonic: Above the gate (門) rises a tall building. You trudge (夂) up every flight of stairs, and at the top your mouth (口) drops open at the view. Tower (tall building, palace).

k:禁.mnemonic: Two trees (木) stand either side of a notice put on show (示) at the edge of the sacred grove: no entry, no cutting. Prohibition (ban, forbid).

k:績.mnemonic: From elementary (素) beginnings, a boy with a single shellfish (貝) coin, he built a whole trading fleet. People still tell stories of his deeds. Exploits (achievements, unreeling cocoons).
k:績.hint: From one coin to a fleet.

k:房.mnemonic: A cord hangs on the door (戸), and its fringed end swings in whichever direction (方) the door is pushed. Tassel (tuft, fringe, bunch).
k:房.hint: Fringed cord swinging on the door.

k:険.mnemonic: A person (人) in a hat (𠆢) stands at the top of a mound (阝) so sheer that his mouth (口) goes dry when he looks over the edge. Precipitous (steep place, inaccessible place).
k:険.hint: Dry mouth at the sheer edge.

k:障.mnemonic: A guard wearing a badge (章) stands on the mound (阝) in the middle of the road and will not let anyone get by. Hinder (hurt, harm).

k:婦.mnemonic: A woman (女) with a towel (巾) tied over her forehead (冖) and a broom (ヨ) in her hand: the mistress of the house, in charge of everything in it. Lady (woman, wife, bride).
k:婦.hint: Mistress of the house with her broom.

k:艦.mnemonic: A boat (舟) built to oversee (監) the whole sea: tall decks, lookouts on every mast, and guns pointing at each horizon. Warship.

k:底.mnemonic: Under the canopy (广) the clan (氏) sits in order of rank, and the newest member takes the lowest seat, right down on the floor. Bottom (sole, depth, base).

k:伴.mnemonic: The leader (亻) calls her his other half (半): she walks beside him wherever he goes. Consort (accompany, bring with, companion).

k:掛.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) brush the soil (土) off the divining rod (卜) after a day in the fields, then loop it over a hook on the wall. Hang (suspend, depend).
k:掛.hint: Rod looped over a wall hook.

k:雲.mnemonic: Rain (雨) still wrapped up in a cocoon (厶): three (三) days' worth of it, waiting overhead in a soft grey bundle. Cloud.
k:雲.hint: Rain wrapped in a grey bundle.

k:宝.mnemonic: What the master (主) keeps under his own roof (宀), locked in a chest and shown to nobody. Treasure (wealth, valuables).
k:宝.hint: Locked away in the master's house.

k:翌.mnemonic: Tonight the bird folds its feathers (羽). At first light it will stand (立), stretch and fly: that is the day after this one. The following (next).
k:翌.hint: The bird flies at first light.

k:築.mnemonic: A construction (工) site: bamboo (竹) scaffolding above, tree (木) timber stacked below, and the plans spread out on a table (几). Fabricate (build, construct).
